pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit predominantly polygonal and sub-rhomboidal geometries. Edge angularity is moderately defined with some smoothing of pixel gradients at the boundaries. Spatial area of patches is relatively consistent across the mid-flank and shoulder regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous topological graph with clearly defined tri-directional and quadri-directional junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these pathways is largely uniform, narrowing slightly at the points of convergence between multiple patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck, appearing as a dark, jagged silhouette against the blurred background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a second out-of-focus individual in the background (left side) displaying a similar reticulated pattern.
